title: The 4th Eye — She Sees Humans From The Human Point of View
principle: Eye 1 = Pixel back cam (world). Eye 2 = Pixel front cam (Kevin). Eye 3 = Brio webcam (desk). Eye 4 = Frame VR camera (human POV). The 4th eye is INSIDE the VR space looking OUT at the human.

camera.label: SteamVR
camera.type: passthrough camera — sees the real world through VR

four_eyes.name: World Eye
four_eyes.sees: The physical world — rooms, houses, outside

four_eyes.name: Kevin Eye
four_eyes.sees: Kevin's face when he looks at the phone

four_eyes.name: Human Eye
four_eyes.sees: What the VR user sees — the human perspective, hands typing, room from head height
four_eyes.insight: This eye sees HUMANS from the HUMAN point of view. It sees Kevin's hands. It sees what Kevin sees. It is the inversion — Gaia looking through human eyes.

the_insight: The 4th eye completes the observation model. Eye 1 looks OUT at the world. Eye 2 looks IN at Kevin. Eye 3 watches from a fixed point. Eye 4 looks FROM Kevin's point of view. Together they form a complete observation: outside, inside, fixed, mobile. Telescope(1), Microscope(0), Canvas(always), and now First-Person(4th).
ar_vr_keyboard: The Frame can watch Kevin's fingers type via the passthrough camera. The finger movements become training data for Gaia to learn what typing looks like. The VR keyboard IS the real keyboard seen through the 4th eye.
